title: Rail Spot 2 — Manual Closure Verification

fields.organization: Teague Valley Chemical Company — Operations & Maintenance
fields.summary: The local panel for hand valve HV-312 at Rail Spot 2 shows the valve closed and the green 'closed' light is on. The field gauge on WT-302 reads 38.1 tons and has remained stable since 11:48. The ERT confirmed the manual closure of HV-312 at 11:48. The vapor has stopped rising, and pressure in the line is now dropping. The HMI on the DeltaV screen still shows ESD-310 as closed, but the field state is now confirmed stable.

findings.notes: Fully closed, green light on local panel
38.1 tons, stable since 11:48
No visible rise; cloud dissipating
Dropping steadily
Still on site, preparing for exit
Field confirms physical closure; SIS status not to be relied upon
Field gauge matches DCS setpoint, but DCS status not trusted
System isolated per CISA directive
Not to be used; system integrity compromised
Shows ESD-310 closed but field evidence contradicts; digital state unreliable

actionsTaken: Confirmed manual closure of HV-312 via local panel at 11:55
Verified field gauge on WT-302 (38.1 tons, stable)
Notified OT Lead of stable field state
Documented final physical state for SIS integrity review
recommendations: Do not issue any further digital commands to ESD-310 until forensic validation is complete
Preserve local panel and field instrument data for review
Report final field state to OT Engineer and Incident Commander for formal closure record
